name: Winter Open Las Condes 2026

venue.name: [OH Salad](https://www.ohsalad.cl/)
venue.address: Cerro El Plomo 5630, Local 105. Las Condes. Ciudad de Santiago.
venue.details: Once inside the venue, go upstairs to "El Castaño" and turn right. The competition will be inside the "OH Salad" restaurant.

information:
**Español** Nos complace anunciar esta competencia de speedcubing en el local OH Salad, esperamos que este sea un evento emocionante para competidores, familia y amigos. Los esperamos !!!

**English** We are pleased to announce this speedcubing competition at the OH Salad food shop. We hope to make this an exciting event for competitors, family, and friends. We look forward to seeing you there!
